replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
As you stated, there's already a function which allows you to see which names you've gone by.
I believe our developers are also willing to implement a feature in which all your in-game ranks are shown as a whole, so I don't think that part would be necessary.
The rest, I agree with. It'd be neat to have that implemented.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
I think it might cause some lag if you include all of that information though. Maybe limit it to....
  • Pvp K/D
  • Credits
  • Ranking (In DTM shows DTM rank, Nexus shows Nexus rank.) 
With your idea, advertising could be intergrated such as a message alongside the stats/information saying..

"Want to see more statistics and information? Visit your profile at (whatever the link is)

The ranking I think would look better as a number in brackets next to your name. People will see their rank often and strive to reach higher.

Ex: [2] Awesomerp: Hi.

Not only will this provide more information, but it will also create more user traffic on the website which is a good thing.
